name: Zoo Teen Volunteers (Junior Camp Counselor, Leader in Training, Teen Conservation Club)
what_you_do: Help run Zoo Camp as a Junior Camp Counselor or Leader in Training, or join the Teen Conservation Club for monthly meetings and conservation projects.
who_can_apply: Current junior high or high school students. Junior Camp Counselors give at least 3 weeks of summer Zoo Camp (about 100 hours). Leaders in Training give 4 summer weeks (about 130 hours). Special-event volunteers can be 13 or older.
duration: Junior Camp Counselor: 7 hours a day, Mon-Fri, 3 summer weeks plus 1 fall week and 2 winter weeks
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The Zoo volunteer page says it is not taking new volunteer recruitment applications at this time (that line sits in the adult sign-up steps), yet the teen sections still show application links. The Leader in Training dates (June 17 to Aug 23) have no year.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply links under Teens on the Zoo volunteer page (junior camp counselor application plus a reference letter). Call or email the Zoo to confirm before you plan.
notes: Confirm first. The Zoo says no internships are available at this time. The Zoo held a Job and Volunteer Fair on February 22 (year not on the page).
